name: commonwealth-mcp
description: Virginia government records over MCP — parcels, zoning, addresses, boundaries, buildings, roads, public places, monitored environmental sites, and the Code of Virginia — with the government system and retrieval date on every answer.

interface.shortDescription: Look up Virginia parcels, zoning, and state law
interface.longDescription: Commonwealth-MCP connects Codex to Virginia's own government systems: parcels, zoning districts, address points, jurisdiction boundaries, buildings, roads, public places, DEQ monitoring stations, and the Code of Virginia. Every answer names the system it came from, the date it was retrieved, and what the source says it does not cover.
